CommunityApplications.Profile:
Unraid Community Applications template for **MagicMirror²**, the open source modular smart mirror platform.
The template runs MagicMirror² in **server-only mode**, which is the right fit for a headless Unraid box: MagicMirror² renders in your browser (or on a separate client device such as a Raspberry Pi) instead of on a locally attached display.
The container image used by this template is `karsten13/magicmirror`, built and maintained by [Karsten Hassel](https://gitlab.com/khassel/magicmirror). This repository only provides the Unraid packaging — it does not fork, rebuild or modify the image.
**Where to get help**
* Problems with the Unraid template itself (paths, ports, permissions): [open an issue here](https://github.com/heckpiet/magicmirror-unraid/issues) * Problems with the container image: [khassel/magicmirror on GitLab](https://gitlab.com/khassel/magicmirror/-/issues) * Problems with MagicMirror² or its modules: [MagicMirror² forum](https://forum.magicmirror.builders/)
